restrictions.text: Over 8'6" wide, over 80' long or over 130,000 lb: no travel 7-9 AM or 3-7 PM Monday-Friday on freeways and arterials.
Over 80' long: no travel 7-9 AM or 3-7 PM Monday-Friday on freeways and arterials.
Over 130,000 lb: no travel 7-9 AM or 3-7 PM Monday-Friday on freeways and arterials.

Holidays: no Sat/Sun/Mon travel for Memorial Day, Victory Day (2nd Mon Aug), Labor Day, MLK Day, Columbus Day weekends; no day or previous-night travel on Independence Day, Veterans Day, Christmas, New Year's; no Wednesday-Sunday travel Thanksgiving week; no Saturday night or Sunday travel Easter.

Holiday restrictions in 31-25-21(f) apply to permitted moves generally (Memorial/Victory/Labor/MLK/Columbus weekends Sat-Mon, July 4/Veterans/Christmas/New Year's plus prior night, Thanksgiving Wed-Sun, Easter Sat night-Sun).

RICR regulation (text unchanged since 2002) still says daylight only (30 min before sunrise to 30 min after sunset) and no moves sunset Friday to sunrise Monday; the 2022 statute rewrite lists only peak-hour and holiday bans. Confirm current night/weekend policy with RIDOT before planning.

travel.holidays: No travel from noon the day before through the holiday; a Monday or Friday holiday closes the long weekend
closures: mon, tue, wed, thu, fri 07:00–09:00: 31-25-21(f)(1): no travel 7-9 a.m. on freeways and arterials (over 8'6" wide, 80' long or 130,000 lb)
mon, tue, wed, thu, fri 15:00–19:00: 31-25-21(f)(1): no travel 3-7 p.m. Monday-Friday
travel.note: Follows R.I. Gen. Laws 31-25-21(f) as amended 2022 (peak-hour and holiday bans; the former night/weekend clause (f)(2) was deleted). The 2002 RICR regulation still reads daylight only, no weekends - the statute controls.

notes: Escort also required for 30,000 lb or more on any axle and whenever the permit reviewer decides (RIDOT FAQ); axle weights not modeled.
Police: buildings moved need local/state police escort; on the Jamestown Bridge loads over 9' wide must arrange police to halt traffic at one end. No general police trigger.
Superload (>= 200,000 lb, route dependent) requires an independent third-party structural analysis of every structure on the route at the carrier's cost (not priced).
Permits cover state-maintained roads only; Mount Hope and Newport (Pell) bridges (RI Bridge Authority) and city/town streets need their own permission.
Extra-large loads (beyond New England consortium limits) need applications 5 working days ahead.
